# The payable side of fx_usd_invoice_overpaid_into_an_hkd_bank.txt: a 100.00
# USD bill overpaid out of an HKD bank, in a CAD-base book.
#
# Every sign inverts — a payable is settled by a debit and the cash goes out —
# and the rate the overpayment was acquired at is measured the same way: the
# bank's whole figure over everything it paid for. 1,560.00 HKD at 0.172 is
# 268.32 CAD for 200.00 USD, so 1.3416, and the 100.00 USD of vendor prepayment
# left over stands at 134.16 CAD. Less cash extinguishing more liability is a
# gain on this side.
#
# What this fixture produces:
#
#   Assets:Bank:HKD             -1,560.00 HKD   value -268.32 CAD
#   A/P USD     100.00 USD                      value  140.00 CAD  (the bill)
#   A/P USD     100.00 USD                      value  134.16 CAD  (prepaid)
#   Income:FX Gain                                     -5.84 CAD   ($residual$)
#
# and `fx-balances` listing the prepayment as 100.00 USD available at 1.3416.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_settling_into_a_third_currency.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank:HKD
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "HKD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD
	type: Accounts Payable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Supplies
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:FX Gain
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

vendor "V-US"
	name: "US Vendor"
	currency: USD

bill "BILL-USD-OVER-HKD"
	vendor_id: "V-US"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-01-05
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-05
		description: "Parts"
		action: "Materials"
		account: "Expenses:Supplies"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-05
		due: 2026-02-05
		ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD"
		memo: "Bill BILL-USD-OVER-HKD"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-02-25
		amount: 200
		account: "Assets:Bank:HKD"
		settled_amount: 1560.00
		prepayment: 100
		memo: "Payment for BILL-USD-OVER-HKD"
		Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD
